notes: Search pagination is page_number (param: page) with items_per_page in {24, 48, 96} (default 48). /search products live at data.products[]; total_pages reported in data.total_pages. Either query OR manufacturer_id required for /search. /product-details and /product-reviews require sku; /product-details accepts piid (option ids from data.options) to select a color/size option. /product-reviews is paginated (10 per page) and includes an AI summary + aspect sentiments. domain: com, ca, co.uk, ie (de is no longer supported). rapidapi_host matches our RapidAPI listing real-time-wayfair-data (also the host in the spec and Lambda code).
